source_note: platform.openai.com/docs/pricing answered 301 Moved Permanently to developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (OpenAI's own docs domain); the redirect target was fetched. https://openai.com/api/pricing answered HTTP 403 and was not used. No third-party source was used.
fetch_method: WebFetch (page converted to text and read back); prices transcribed from that text
context_tiers: Short context: <=272K input tokens. Long context: >272K input tokens. (quoted from the pricing page)

caching_rules_quoted.minimum_cacheable_prefix: The minimum cacheable prompt length is 1,024 tokens for GPT-5.6 and later and varies by request settings for earlier models.
caching_rules_quoted.cache_write_rate: For GPT-5.6 and later: cache writes cost 1.25x the standard, uncached input-token rate.
caching_rules_quoted.cache_write_not_additive: Cache-write pricing is not an additive fee: input tokens use the uncached-input, cached-input, or cache-write rate.
caching_rules_quoted.cache_read_rate: Subsequent reads cost 0.1x that rate on most of these models and 0.05x on GPT-6.1 Sol.
caching_rules_quoted.implicit_mode: Implicit caching is automatic and does incur write charges. When prompt_cache_options.mode is implicit, OpenAI places a breakpoint at the end of the latest eligible message.
caching_rules_quoted.retention: GPT-5.6 and later: A cached prefix remains eligible for reuse for 30 minutes after its most recent write or reuse.

selection.why: The page's first rows (its 'Our latest models' section) are the gpt-6 family in three price tiers: gpt-6-astra (10.00 in / 50.00 out), gpt-6-sol and gpt-6.1-sol (2.00 / 10.00), gpt-6-luna (0.10 / 0.50). Cheap small = the cheapest current-generation model, gpt-6-luna. Mid-tier = the middle tier of that family; gpt-6.1-sol is its newer revision (listed second, ahead of gpt-6-sol), same input/output price as gpt-6-sol with a lower cached-input price.

other_rows_short_context.note: Remaining text-model rows as transcribed (input / cached_input / output); null = no cached price shown.
other_rows_short_context.page_note_quoted: GPT-5.6 Sol's promotional pricing is available at least through November 21, 2026.
